[P2] Document SDK-owned replay through the suite-aware API

`collect_and_adjudicate` requires an SDK-owned `SuiteDefinition` whose coverage profile differs from `standard`. However, the advertised CLI calls `load_manifest()` without a suite and accepts only `standard`, so it rejects the public collection API's manifests with `Unknown coverage profile` before reading their captures. The round-trip test misses this because it uses the private collector with a standard manifest. Document SDK-owned replay through `adjudicate_collected_evidence(..., suite=suite)`, identify the CLI example as standard-only, and test replay using the public collection API.
